entities.name: John
entities.description: One of the two speakers, a married father of at least two young children who talks with his friend Maria roughly every fortnight between December 2022 and August 2023. He wants to get into local politics to improve education and infrastructure in his community, ran for office more than once without success, blogged about policy and attended community meetings. He worked at a mechanical engineering company, was promoted to assistant manager in June 2023 and lost the job in August 2023 when the company collapsed, after which he was looking at the tech industry. He failed the military aptitude test in late 2022, retook it with good results in March 2023, and does a great deal of veterans' advocacy; he also joined a volunteer fire-fighting brigade in July 2023, which he called his true calling. He does kickboxing, beginner yoga, family boot camps and camping, and grew up in West County.

entities.name: Maria
entities.description: The other speaker, a long-standing volunteer at a local homeless shelter which she joined around August 2022 after seeing a family struggling on the streets. She also volunteers monthly at a dog shelter, joined a nearby church in May 2023 and a gym in June 2023, and does aerial yoga, kundalini yoga, hiking and camping. She has a small family she is close to, was inspired to volunteer by her aunt, took a solo trip to Spain in 2022, a creative writing class and a poetry class, and acquired two dogs, Coco and Shadow, in the summer of 2023. Her grandmother died in early March 2023 and she was in a car crash on 2 July 2023.

entities.name: John's family

properties.aliases: the family; the wife and kids; the missus and the kids

entities.description: The group John lives with and calls his rock — his wife (never named, referred to as 'the wife' and 'the missus') and their children, who include the son Kyle and the daughter Sara. They go to the park and on picnics several times a week, cook and eat together, make pizza, do family boot-camp workouts three times a week, took a road trip in 2022 and vacations to California and the Pacific Northwest, and kept the dog Max for ten years until his death in June 2023. John says they are why he never gives up.

entities.name: Kyle
entities.description: John's son, one year old in March 2023 and the baby in the family photo John shared that month.

entities.name: Sara
entities.description: John's daughter. The family trip photographed on a railway track in the autumn of 2022 was taken on a trip for her birthday.

entities.name: Maria's family

properties.aliases: my fam; my family; my mom; my siblings

entities.description: Maria's small family, which she relies on for strength and which she says has been her rock through a hard 2023. It includes her mother, with whom she cooked dinner on 3 May 2023, the siblings she made memories with as a child, her aunt and her cousin. The family had money problems when Maria was young and took a road trip to Oregon and a vacation to Florida.

entities.name: Maria's aunt
entities.description: Maria's aunt, who believed in volunteering and helped Maria's family through their money troubles when Maria was young. She is the reason Maria started volunteering herself.

entities.name: Maria's cousin
entities.description: Maria's cousin, who had to leave her home in a hurry in the summer of 2023 and was looking for a new place; Maria was helping her and asked John for organizations that could assist.

entities.name: Jean
entities.description: A woman Maria met while volunteering on 24 February 2023. Jean had been through a divorce, lost her job and become homeless, yet stayed optimistic, valued small things and believed in the good of kindness; Maria took her as a lesson in gratitude and connection.

entities.name: David
entities.description: A man Maria met at the charity event on 3 February 2023 whose story of hardship humbled her. She afterwards linked him up with a nearby organization offering housing and support to homeless people.

entities.name: Laura
entities.description: A resident of the homeless shelter who wrote the volunteers a letter of gratitude, which Maria found inspiring and shared with John in July 2023.

entities.name: Cindy

properties.aliases: one of the residents at the shelter

entities.description: A resident of the homeless shelter who wrote a heartfelt note of gratitude that Maria showed John in August 2023.

entities.name: Samuel
entities.description: An elderly veteran John met on his visit to a veterans' hospital in July 2023. His stories were inspiring and heartbreaking and reminded John why he had wanted to join the military.

entities.name: Rob
entities.description: A colleague of John's who invited him to a beginner's yoga class in February 2023; John started going to a weekend yoga class with a colleague in April 2023.

entities.name: Max
entities.description: John's family dog of ten years, who died around 3 June 2023. John remembers him as peaceful and happy in the backyard and says he taught the family unconditional love and loyalty; their best time together was a camping trip in the summer of 2022 where they hiked and swam.

entities.name: Coco
entities.description: Maria's white puppy, acquired about two weeks before 11 August 2023. She greets Maria at the door, and caring for her has been an adjustment that Maria says is worth it. She gets along with Maria's second dog, Shadow.

entities.name: Shadow

properties.aliases: Shadow; the little one; the new pup

entities.description: A black puppy Maria adopted from a shelter in the week before 13 August 2023. She is full of energy, was learning commands and house training, and gets along with Maria's other dog, Coco.

entities.name: West County
entities.description: The area John came from and still calls his old area. He wants to work on improving it, he helped renovate a rundown community centre there in 2022, and it was hit by a bad flood in early July 2023 in which poor infrastructure meant many homes were ruined.

entities.name: London
entities.description: The city in England Maria visited a few years before 2023. Its architecture and castles captivated her, and she recreated some of that charm at home in a shadow box and a painting.

entities.name: England
entities.description: The country Maria travelled to a few years before 2023, where the castles mesmerised her; her trip was to London.

entities.name: Spain
entities.description: Where Maria took a transformative solo trip in 2022. She photographed a beach and a small island there, learned the value of solitude and of letting go, and tried surfing for the first time.

entities.name: Oregon
entities.description: Where Maria's family went on a road trip when she was younger; they hiked to a waterfall with a bridge over it that she remembers as fairy-tale-like.

entities.name: California
entities.description: Where John's family had a vacation he remembers for a gorgeous sunset and an evening stroll along the shore.

entities.name: Florida
entities.description: Where Maria had a family vacation she photographed; the colours of the sunset over the water and sitting with her family left her feeling grateful.

entities.name: The Pacific Northwest

properties.aliases: the coast up in the Pacific Northwest

entities.description: The region John and his family explored on a road trip in 2022, taking in the coast and several national parks; he calls the nature there breathtaking.

entities.name: The homeless shelter Maria volunteers at
entities.description: The local homeless shelter Maria has volunteered at since about August 2022 and the centre of most of her charity work: she donated her old car to it, served at events for children, gave talks, organized meals, ran a fundraiser with a chili cook-off, ran a 5K charity run for it, dropped off baked goods, staffed the front desk and was given a medal in August 2023. She calls the people there like family, and met Jean, Laura and other residents through it.

entities.name: Maria's church
entities.description: The nearby church Maria joined on 5 May 2023 to feel closer to a community and to her faith. Her friends from it went camping with her over 10-11 June 2023, had a picnic and a hike with her in July 2023, and did community work with her in August 2023.

entities.name: Maria's gym
entities.description: The gym Maria joined in the week before 16 June 2023, where she is sticking to a workout routine and finds the people and atmosphere welcoming; she also went to dinner with friends from it on 7 July 2023.

entities.name: John's yoga studio
entities.description: The studio John goes to often, with a chill vibe and instructors he rates. It offers yoga, kickboxing and circuit training; John has done the beginner yoga class and weight training there.

entities.name: John's fire-fighting brigade

properties.aliases: the fire-fighting brigade; the fire brigade

entities.description: The volunteer fire-fighting brigade John joined on 31 July 2023 after intense training. Its first call-out with him, on 30 July 2023, saved a family from a burning building; it also ran a two-hour donation drive in August 2023 whose proceeds helped buy a new fire truck. John calls the crew family and the work his true calling.

entities.name: John's service-focused online group

properties.aliases: a service-focused online group; the virtual support group

entities.description: The online group devoted to service that John joined at the end of December 2022, taken here to be the same as the virtual support group he asked family and friends to join in August 2023 and the organization he described as a family in July 2023. Its members met in person to hand out food and supplies at a homeless shelter and to run a toy drive, and were brainstorming projects giving underserved communities education, mentorship, job training and resume help.

entities.name: The mechanical engineering company John worked for
entities.description: John's employer until August 2023. He was promoted to assistant manager there around 16 June 2023 after years of hurdles including self-doubt, enjoyed the team in July 2023, and lost the job around 5 August 2023 when the company collapsed.

entities.name: The tech company John hoped to join
entities.description: A tech company John thought he had found a job with in August 2023, which needed his mechanical skills for its hardware team; he had been looking at the tech industry for a while before losing his engineering job.

entities.name: The local school John helps at
entities.description: A school in John's community. He volunteered at a career fair there over the weekend of 1-2 April 2023 and saw how a lack of resources limits the pupils' dreams, and from August 2023 he volunteered there as a mentor, where the students' confidence and skills visibly improved. The two mentions are joined here because both describe volunteering at a local school in his own community, though the conversation never names it.

entities.name: The local dog shelter

properties.aliases: a local dog shelter; a shelter

entities.description: The dog shelter Maria started volunteering at once a month on 3 June 2023, and taken here to be where she adopted the puppy Shadow in August 2023. She offered to help John's family find a rescue dog through it.

entities.name: John's community food drive
entities.description: The food drive John started helping with on 5 February 2023 for people in his community who had lost their jobs, prompted by the effect unemployment was having on his neighbours. The response from the community and from volunteers overwhelmed him, and Maria offered to help with networking and future events.

entities.name: John's project to support military veterans
entities.description: The project John was running from May 2023 to show appreciation for military veterans and support their rights, built around a petition. It was rewarding but stressful, it reconnected him with old friends, and it included a small party on 19 May 2023 where veterans shared their stories.

entities.name: John's politics blog
entities.description: The blog about politics and government John had been writing by April 2023, researching policies — chiefly education reform and infrastructure development — and publishing his ideas to raise awareness and start conversations. He had good feedback on the early posts.

entities.name: Kickboxing
entities.description: The workout class John was doing in December 2022, which he said gave him a lot of energy; Maria called it a good way to stay in shape and de-stress. Kickboxing is also one of the classes offered at the yoga studio he later joined.

entities.name: Aerial yoga
entities.description: The exercise Maria had just started in December 2022 and still enjoyed in June 2023, when she called it a way to switch off and focus on her body; her favourite poses are the upside-down ones.

entities.name: Yoga
entities.description: The beginner yoga John took up on 7 April 2023 after his colleague invited him in February, focused on fundamentals of poses and breathing. He made it part of his daily routine for flexibility, relaxation and mindfulness, and goes to a studio he likes. Maria separately does aerial yoga and was trying kundalini yoga in June 2023.

entities.name: John's family boot camps
entities.description: The boot-camp workouts John started doing with his family in April 2023, three times a week, for bonding and fitness. They gained energy, strength and endurance, supported each other through the sessions, and his children became keen on staying active.

entities.name: Camping
entities.description: Something both speakers do. John has camped plenty of times, likes how uncomplicated it is, and camped with his dog Max in the summer of 2022; Maria has camped a few times and went camping with friends from her church over 10-11 June 2023.

entities.name: John's car
entities.description: The car John drives to work. Its windshield was broken in an unexpected incident on his way home in early January 2023, and it broke down on Friday 7 April 2023, with the repairs straining his finances.

entities.name: Maria's cross necklace
entities.description: A cross necklace Maria bought around April 2023 to feel closer to her faith, which made her happy; she joined a church for the same reason the following month.

claims.text: Maria's family is small but she relies on them for strength in tough times, and John says family is the most important thing to him and his biggest support through good times and bad.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: John's family have supported each other through the boot camp, cheering each other on during workouts and giving emotional support outside them.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: Maria and her mother cooked dinner together on 3 May 2023 — a spread of salads, sandwiches and homemade desserts.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: John baked an apple pie for his children on 3 May 2023.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: Maria's favourite treat is a banana split sundae, which she enjoys after a day of volunteering as a small moment of joy.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: Maria finds balance by taking care of herself physically, emotionally and mentally — exercise, music and time with loved ones — which helps her stay positive.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: Maria took a solo trip to Spain in 2022 and photographed a beach and a small island there; the trip reminded her that life is hard but there is still hope and beauty, and taught her to rely on her inner strength and appreciate small moments.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: What Maria took from her solo trip to Spain was the value of different perspectives, the power of solitude, and the importance of letting go and trusting life.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: Maria tried surfing for the first time on her solo trip to Spain in 2022; she kept falling off, and says it taught her the power of not giving up and of trying new things.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: John decided in the week before 6 May 2023 to run for office again, even though he had not been successful before, saying he cannot let go of his dream of making a difference in his community — though he also admitted it sometimes feels like too much.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: As of 6 May 2023 Maria had been doing charity work that left her feeling connected and fulfilled.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: Maria joined a nearby church on 5 May 2023 to feel closer to a community and to her faith, and said it had been great so far.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: Maria said on 6 May 2023 that life had been a bit rough lately but she was alright, and was taking time to reflect and find some balance.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: There was a power cut in John's area in the week before 6 May 2023, which made him realise how important upgrading the infrastructure is for stable services.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: The other infrastructure problem in John's area is the roadways, which are full of potholes, dangerous for drivers and damaging to cars.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: On 6 May 2023 John said he was thinking about starting a community project on infrastructure, and suggested he and Maria work together to get the neighbourhood behind it.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John and Maria agreed on 6 May 2023 that everyone should have access to affordable housing, and that they would push for better housing and living conditions in their neighbourhood.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John also wants to work on improving West County, the old area he came from, as well as his current neighbourhood.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: By 20 May 2023 John was busy with a project to support military veterans and was trying to get a petition going, which he found rewarding but stressful.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John took on the veterans project because he has always been passionate about veterans and their rights; in the week before 20 May 2023 he was struck again by how much they have done, and wanted to show his appreciation and give back.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: Maria offered on 20 May 2023 to help with John's project supporting veterans, and he said her help would make a real impact.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: On Friday 19 May 2023 John and his team threw a small party and invited veterans to share their stories; he found the connections, camaraderie and new friendships heartwarming and said their support keeps him motivated.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: As of 20 May 2023 Maria was planning a ring-toss tournament for the homeless shelter's fundraiser later that month.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: By 25 May 2023 John's veterans petition was proving tricky, but it had brought him back in touch with his old friends and was gaining support.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John shared a photo of his workmates from a hiking trip they took to a waterfall, and said they are what keeps him going.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: Maria was busy at the homeless shelter preparing a fundraiser for the week after 25 May 2023, hoping to raise enough to cover basic needs for homeless people.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: The shelter fundraiser Maria was organizing included a chili cook-off; she asked John to help spread the word with the poster and to find people willing to volunteer at the event, and he agreed to ask around.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: John shared a photo of his family at the beach at sunset on 25 May 2023 and said moments like that are what give him hope; Maria said the picture gave her peace and made her appreciate life.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John's community work broadened steadily through the first half of 2023: from wanting to get into local politics in December 2022, he went to a community meeting in January, joined a food drive in February, started blogging about education reform and infrastructure in April, decided in May 2023 to run for office again, and took on a petition for military veterans.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John's family dog Max died around 3 June 2023, after ten years as an important part of the family; John said the hardest part was knowing he was not there wagging his tail any more.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John and his family took comfort in the good times they had with Max, and John shared a cherished photo of him lying peacefully in the backyard.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John says Max taught his family about unconditional love and loyalty, and he wants his children to learn that from the bond they had with him.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: After Max died, John's family were considering adopting a rescue dog, both for the love and to teach the children responsibility and compassion.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: Maria started volunteering at a local dog shelter once a month, around 3 June 2023, and offered to help John's family if they decided to adopt.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: Maria went camping with some friends from her church over the weekend of 10-11 June 2023; she called it a blast and something nice to take her mind off things.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: John went on a mountaineering trip with some workmates in the week before 12 June 2023, reached the summit, and said the tough climb and the stunning view helped clear his head after losing Max.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: Maria's family went on a road trip to Oregon when she was younger; the prettiest part was hiking to a waterfall with a bridge over it, which she says felt like a fairy tale and sounded calming.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: Maria has been camping a few times but has never tried mountain climbing; John has camped plenty of times and loves how uncomplicated it is and how it lets him get away from everything.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: Maria finds her peace in a moment to herself with her favourite music, and in aerial yoga, which she says lets her switch off and focus on her body; her favourite poses are the upside-down ones, which make her feel free and light.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: John spent a day at the park with his family around 12 June 2023, where the children had a lot of fun on the playground.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: Maria joined a gym in the week before 16 June 2023, was sticking to her workout routine, and found the people and the atmosphere there welcoming.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: Maria's fitness goals in June 2023 were to get stronger and improve her endurance, and she was trying kundalini yoga.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: In June 2023 John was trying out different workout regimes and liked the idea of rock climbing as a way to push his limits; Maria had never tried it.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John was promoted to assistant manager at work around 16 June 2023, after what he called a long time coming, and was over the moon about it.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John keeps a golden trophy that commemorates his journey to the promotion and symbolises the obstacles he had to overcome.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: The hurdles John faced on the way to his promotion were technical and workplace problems, but the worst was self-doubt about whether he was on the right track; support at home and his own grit got him through.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John usually works regular hours but sometimes brings work home, and balances it by organizing his time so he is there for the important things.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John and his family had a vacation in California that he remembers for a gorgeous sunset and an evening stroll along the shore.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: Maria has a photo from a family vacation in Florida — a sunset over the water with a bird flying in the distance — and remembers feeling grateful sitting there with her family; John shared a picture of his own children playing in the waves.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: Maria said on 27 June 2023 that she had been struggling, but was focusing on the positive and relying on her friends and family for support.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: Maria's family were her rock through her difficult June 2023, giving her encouragement and reminding her she was not alone.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: John and his family went to a live music event in the week before 27 June 2023; he loved seeing them dancing and called the energy amazing.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: Maria's silver lining during her hard June 2023 was volunteering at the homeless shelter, which made her feel good about helping even for a short while.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: Maria's standout memory from the homeless shelter is someone who had been sad for months suddenly laughing while she played with the children there; she says being able to make a difference brings her joy.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: Maria met three children at the homeless shelter shortly before 3 July 2023 and said their smiles warmed her heart.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: On 2 July 2023 a car ran a red light and hit the car Maria was in; the car was badly damaged but everyone was unhurt.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: Maria's cousin had to leave her home in a hurry in the summer of 2023 and was under stress finding a new place; Maria was helping her look, and said she was making progress.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: John offered on 3 July 2023 to look for resources and organizations that could help Maria's cousin find somewhere to live.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: Laura, one of the residents of the homeless shelter, wrote the volunteers a letter expressing her gratitude, which Maria found inspiring and shared with John in July 2023.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: John took part in a marching event for veterans' rights around 3 July 2023, out of his long-standing respect for the military; being among people who shared his values reminded him how much veterans sacrifice and motivated him to keep up his activism.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: On 5 July 2023 John reflected that education and infrastructure shape communities and that their lack stunts a neighbourhood's growth; he said it sometimes feels like an uphill battle and that he doubts whether he is making a difference, but that knowing people like Maria value the work keeps him going.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John shared a photo of his family posing on a railway track, taken on a trip in 2022 for his daughter Sara's birthday, and said his family motivate him and remind him why he keeps striving for change.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: Maria is inspired by talking to people, volunteering and listening to music; John is inspired by his family, exercise and spending time with friends.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: John photographed a sunset over the ocean on a walk in the week before 5 July 2023, and says he sees a sunset like that at least once a week on his walks, which he uses to disconnect and find peace.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: By July 2023 Maria had been taking regular 'me-time' walks at a park near her, which she says has made a big difference.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: West County, the area John came from, was hit by a bad flood in the week before 7 July 2023; the infrastructure was poor, so many homes were ruined, and it reinforced John's view that his community needs fixing up.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: After the flood John was getting people together for a meeting to discuss solutions, and Maria agreed on 7 July 2023 to join it and contribute.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John and Maria agreed on 7 July 2023 to keep working together on their community, saying small actions add up and that their friendship and shared passion make the work possible.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: Maria was going out to dinner with some friends from her gym on 7 July 2023.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: John visited a veterans' hospital in the week before 17 July 2023, met people there, and came away appreciating what he has and feeling the need to give back.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: At the veterans' hospital John heard stories from an elderly veteran named Samuel; he found them inspiring and heartbreaking, and said the veterans' resilience reminded him why he had wanted to join the military.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John says the organization he does his veterans work with is like a family whose members always support each other.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: Maria had a picnic with friends from her church over the weekend of 15-16 July 2023; they sat under the trees, ate and played games including charades and a scavenger hunt.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: John was thinking of setting up games and arts and crafts for his children and friends, having seen such activities at a community event in June 2023 where families were having a great time.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John's involvement with the military ran from failing the aptitude test at the end of 2022, through retaking it with good results in March 2023, to a petition and a party for veterans in May 2023, a march for veterans' rights in July 2023 and a visit to a veterans' hospital that same month.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: As of 22 July 2023 John was really enjoying his new job, where he found his team encouraging and inspiring.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: Maria went hiking with friends from her church over the weekend of 15-16 July 2023 to make connections, laugh together and take in nature; reaching the top and seeing the view gave her a sense of peace and of being part of something bigger.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: Maria's plan as of 22 July 2023 was to explore more and to volunteer at shelters in August 2023.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: John goes often to a yoga studio he likes for its chill vibe and its instructors; it offers a range of classes including yoga, kickboxing and circuit training, which he says keeps things interesting.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: As well as yoga, John had done weight training at his studio by July 2023 and found it challenging but peaceful, much like yoga.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: Maria said on 22 July 2023 that she was off to bake some cakes.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: Maria dropped the things she had baked off at the homeless shelter in the week before 31 July 2023, and said it left her more motivated than ever to help people.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: John joined a fire-fighting brigade around 31 July 2023, saying Maria's work at the homeless shelter had made him think about how he could give back to his own community.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: The fire brigade's training was intense and taxing for John, but he says it changed his view on helping others.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John's fire brigade had its first call-out with him on Sunday 30 July 2023: the scene was chaotic when they arrived, but the team pulled together and saved a family from a burning building.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John said on 31 July 2023 that his fire brigade colleagues had become like family, with different skills but a shared purpose, and that it was a bond he had not felt since his time in the military — although in January 2023 he had told Maria he failed the military aptitude test.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: Maria shared a photo from her volunteering on 31 July 2023 and said it reminds her that being kind matters and that she intends to keep it up.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: John asked his family and friends on 3 August 2023 to join the virtual support group he belongs to and to become advocates for the military, and was pleased by how many people came together to back those serving.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: As of 3 August 2023 Maria was still volunteering at the homeless shelter and finding it rewarding.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: Maria started volunteering at the homeless shelter about a year before August 2023, after seeing a family struggling on the streets; she contacted the shelter herself to ask whether they needed volunteers, and has found it fulfilling ever since, though tough.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: Cindy, one of the residents at the homeless shelter, wrote a note of heartfelt gratitude that Maria showed John in August 2023 as evidence of the impact the support has.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: John took his children to a military memorial in the week before 3 August 2023; they were awestruck and humbled, and he said teaching them to respect those who served matters to him.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John lost his job at the mechanical engineering company around 5 August 2023 when the company collapsed; he said he never saw it coming and it had been really rough.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John had been looking into opportunities in the tech industry for a while before losing his engineering job, and thought the redundancy might be the change he needed; he credited Maria with the push.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: By 5 August 2023 John thought he had found a job at a tech company he likes, which needs his mechanical skills for its hardware team; he called it a great opportunity to learn and contribute.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: Maria took up some community work with her friends from church on 4 August 2023 and found it super rewarding.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: John had not been able to volunteer much in 2023, but in 2022 he helped renovate a rundown community centre back home in West County; it took a lot of work and he says the centre is now busy and the impact on the community was worth it.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: Maria was given a medal by the homeless shelter in the week before 9 August 2023 for her volunteering, which she found humbling.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: John took part in a community fundraising event over the weekend of 5-6 August 2023 which drew a great turnout and a lot of supportive people.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: The event John ran over the weekend of 5-6 August 2023 was a 5K charity run he set up in his neighbourhood to raise funds for veterans and their families, and it did raise money.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: Organizing the 5K charity run meant getting sponsors, coordinating with the city and spreading the word; getting sponsors was the hardest part and John had to reach out to several businesses, but he ended up with good sponsors that made the event a hit.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John's group also worked with a local organization that helps victims of domestic abuse, raising awareness and funds for the cause at their event.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: Maria got a puppy called Coco about two weeks before 11 August 2023, a white dog she calls adorable.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: Coco brings Maria joy and always greets her when she comes home; looking after the puppy has been an adjustment but Maria says it is totally worth it.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: John was still thinking about his dog Max in August 2023 and shared photos of him.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John's best memory of Max is a camping trip in the summer of 2022 where they hiked and swam; he describes it as peaceful, a break from the hustle, and like restarting his mind and spirit.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John said on 11 August 2023 that he had been having a tough time, did not feel he was making much of an impact, and was questioning his decisions and goals; he wanted to find a better way to focus his passion.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: On Maria's suggestion John agreed on 11 August 2023 to research local organizations and volunteering programmes that suit his beliefs, make a list of them and reach out for information.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: By 13 August 2023 John was volunteering as a mentor at a local school and finding it rewarding to see how much he could help the students.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: Maria adopted a black puppy called Shadow from a shelter in the week before 13 August 2023; she is full of energy, gets along with Maria's other dog, and Maria said she felt blessed to give her a home.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: Maria had no pets growing up, but says having a furry companion now brightens her days.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: John said on 13 August 2023 that he would look into shelters near him soon, as it would be great to have a new dog in the house.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: The students John mentors have visibly improved in confidence and skills, and in the week before 13 August 2023 one of them was excited to show him an essay, which John called a proud moment.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: Maria's puppy Shadow was learning commands and house training by mid-August 2023, and Maria calls her an amazing learner who is fun to work with.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: John's household is himself, his wife and their children, who he says always have his back in hard times; together they hike, go to the park, have picnics, play board games and have movie nights at home.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John said on 16 August 2023 that being part of the fire-fighting brigade gives him a sense of purpose and feels like his true calling.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John was impressed by the dedication of his fire brigade colleagues and how well they worked together, and found being around them inspiring.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John's fire brigade ran a donation drive around 16 August 2023 that took only two hours and collected canned food, toiletries and clothes for people in need.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: The donations raised for the local fire station, which Maria also contributed to, helped pay for a brand new fire truck.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: Maria spent Friday 11 August 2023 volunteering at the homeless shelter's front desk, and said seeing people's faces when they got food or a bed made her feel they really can make a difference.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: John's working life turned over in the summer of 2023: promoted to assistant manager around 16 June 2023 and enjoying the team in July, he lost that job in early August when the mechanical engineering company collapsed, and was then hoping to move into a tech company's hardware team.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: Maria's household went from having no pets at all to two dogs in the summer of 2023: the white puppy Coco at the end of July and the black puppy Shadow, adopted from a shelter, in the second week of August.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: Maria's volunteering widened through 2023 from the homeless shelter she joined around August 2022 — talks, meals, a 5K run and a fundraiser there — to a monthly dog shelter from June 2023 and community work with her church from August 2023, and the shelter gave her a medal in early August 2023.
claims.speaker: Maria

claims.text: John's search for a way to serve moved on through 2023: after losing his job and doubting his impact in August, he had already joined a volunteer fire brigade in July and was mentoring at a local school by 13 August 2023, and called the brigade work his true calling.
claims.speaker: John
